name: Improved Far Shot
body:
Your skill allows you to increase the range of your weapons without sacrificing accuracy.

Prerequisite: Far Shot, BAB +5.

Benefit: When using a ranged weapon, the range of the weapon is increased by 50%.

Normal: A weapon’s range is given in the weapon’s description. When you take this feat, a weapon with a normal 10 ft. range would instead, for you, have a 15 ft. range and a weapon with a 100 ft. range would, in your hands, have a 150 ft. range.
